summary: Regression test after removal of emergentintegrations from requirements.txt and addition of .npmrc. Both backend (5/5 pytest) and frontend (all key flows) working. Landing page loads with no console errors, WhatsApp float visible & positioned bottom-right, PT/EN toggle switches content, nav-cta opens lead-modal, lead submission POSTs to /api/leads and displays success state, product tabs switch, FAQ accordion clickable. Backend endpoints /api/leads (POST/GET), /api/events (POST), /api/analytics/summary (GET) all return 200 with proper data.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); prefer lifespan handler (non-blocking, cosmetic).
POST /api/leads returns 200; RESTful convention would be 201 Created (cosmetic, tests pass either way).
No rate limiting on POST /api/leads which is a public endpoint — could be spammed. Consider basic throttling or captcha for production.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed lead (test_regression@example.com) and one test event (test_regression_event) in MongoDB via API for verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_landing_api.py — run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_landing_api.py -v. The hero headline text is split into 3 spans (['Sua frota','no piloto','automático.']), so text-based selectors must target individual spans or use partial matches. Lenis smooth scroll instance is exposed at window.__lenis — use for programmatic scrolling with {immediate:true}. Lead modal's profile field is a shadcn Select (Radix); to interact use click + keyboard ArrowDown+Enter, or click force=True on options. FAQ items use data-testid='faq-item-N' and are clickable (state attributes may not update visibly — verify via child content visibility if needed).
